Mother Knows Best

by skyrhapsody

Summary

Mydei's luscious golden hair had grown longer over the course of the last few months where they're so busy finishing up assignments and studying for final exams, so Phainon sighed and took out the hair band that he recently wore on his wrist then tapped Mydei's shoulder to show the hair band.

Mydei easily acquiesced, turning his head on the side so Phainon could gather some of the soft hair to tie it into a small bun with practised ease. 

The sound of a loud clink jolted Phainon and he turned to see everyone gaped at him, including Eurypon and Gorgo.

Phainon opened his mouth to ask, but Gorgo had interrupted him, "Mydeimos, why haven't you told us that your relationship has progressed this far?"

Phainon stared at her in confusion, then to Mydei who avoided looking at him but whose cheeks have reddened. 

Gorgo had stood up, "We are here today to celebrate the day that Mydeimos had found an alpha befitting of him. May Mydeimos and Phainon be blessed with happiness from here on, standing strong together until death." 

He had to look panicked, so Mydei hissed, "I'll explain later. Just follow it for now."

"Thank you, mother."

Then he drank the juice in one gulp.

"Welcome to Castrum Kremnos." Mydei's look alike if he was a woman greeted them in front of the majestic door. 

Phainon immediately recognised her as Mydei's mother from the photos that Mydei had shown before. She was gorgeous, her pose graceful as she smiled kindly at them.

"Mother." Mydei didn't hesitate to hug her deeply as she embraced him back.

Phainon had to smile at the sight; he knew Mydei and his mother were close and Mydei hadn't seen her for several months as she's busy with work. Mydei had told him that his mother was his role model, as she taught him how to stand up for himself when he presented as an omega like her. She, who through sheer will, managed to enter the festival where battle prowess were admired and came out on top. It was how she managed to catch the attention of Eurypon, her husband and Mydei's father too.

A man's voice was shouting from inside the house, "Dear, has Mydeimos arrived?"

Then hastened steps followed before an older blond man appeared and smiled at seeing Mydei, "Son."

"Father." 

Mydei got another warm hug before he let himself go and turned around to introduce them to each other.

"Mother, father, these are my friends. Phainon, Aglaea, Castorice and Cipher." 

Pleasantries exchanged, Eurypon and Gorgo invited them inside the mansion. Phainon couldn't stop gawking at the splendour inside. There was even a chandelier, hanging grandly over the hall, although Phainon was more interested in the more unique things like various weapons displayed on the wall or that breastplate inside a glass display.

Aglaea, the oldest in their friend group, had managed to engage Eurypon and Gorgo in a conversation so Phainon saw Mydei was walking alone. He grabbed Mydei's arm lightly, bringing his attention to him.

"Mydei, why do your parents have a collection of weapons?"

Mydei glanced at the collection and replied, "They like to decorate the house with Kremnoan culture to honour it." Then as if it's a trivial matter, he added, "I believe some of them are real."

"What??" Phainon's passion for being an (amateur) antique appraisal was lit, "Which one?"

"That lance, for example." Mydei pointed at one with a crimson shaft, the blade glinting as the light shone on it, "Believed to be wielded during the era of Chrysos Heirs and might be one of Nikador's weapons since he preferred lances over other weapons."

Phainon was so excited that he's shaking Mydei's arm, who's just unperturbed at this point at Phainon's antics, "You have to show me around later."

"I will." 

Phainon felt eyes on him and when he pried his attention away from Mydei's breathtaking side profile, he saw both of Mydei's parents staring at them oddly. 

Mostly at where Phainon's hand had attached itself around Mydei's arm.

Phainon was a touchy person by nature, alpha or not, but he felt scrutinised by the attention. Mydei only gave token protests at the beginning of their friendship before he relented to Phainon's love of physical contacts, but maybe it's not common in Castrum Kremnos? He gingerly unwrapped his hand from Mydei, opened his mouth to say something –maybe apologise?– but to his surprise, Gorgo suddenly approached him with a graceful smile.

"So you are Phainon?"

Gorgo's question seemed casual enough, but Phainon felt her sharp eyes watching over him like she was assessing him?

Phainon was oddly nervous, "Yes, ma'am."

"How do you know Mydeimos?"

"We met at the gym! Mydei was running on treadmills and I immediately took notice of how focused he was." He conveniently left out the part where he stared at Mydei's attractive back and admired the red tank that didn't hide the amazing muscles for an unspecified time until said person noticed and asked what his problem was. "We hit it off immediately!"

Mydei scoffed next to him, "Not until you challenged me for deadlift and lost."

"Yes, but I won at push-ups so what's your point?" Phainon grinned at Mydei's grumble before he brought his attention back to Gorgo, "Mydei is an amazing gym partner and we push each other to be stronger."

"The fact that he's an omega does not bother you?" 

Gorgo clearly prodded Phainon because an alpha-omega friendship formed in a gym was uncommon, so he took the opportunity to praise his best friend to high heaven.

"I didn't realise he was an omega when we first met but the fact that he is makes him even more amazing." Phainon said sincerely, "It was stupid for some alphas to discriminate against omegas when omegas like Mydei exist. We had a good laugh every time there's an alpha who challenged Mydei and came out with crushing defeat."

"What they deserved."

Phainon nodded at Mydei's quip, "They are pathetic. Omegas are strong and they should admit it."

Gorgo gave an approving nod, "And how do you like your… friendship with Mydei?"

There's a weird pause when she said friendship, but Phainon pressed on. He got it. She's a worried mother with an omega son living far away from the city, so she had to know that her son was well. 

Cyrene, Phainon's sister, was an omega too and they had a daily call since she travelled a lot for her work and even if she had her manager with her, Phainon worried.

"Mydei took care of me a lot. He reminded me to eat whenever I was swamped with assignments even cooked for me often! I swear I can eat his golden honeycakes everyday if I could."

"Phainon…"

"Yes?" 

"Stop saying that kind of thing." Mydei's face was pink, an occurrence when Phainon praised him excessively and a sight so cute that Phainon used any opportunity to see it.

Phainon smiled teasingly, "It's true though? I hope you'll cook for me everyday, Mydei."

"I see. Thank you for being good for Mydeimos, Phainon." Gorgo finally seemed satisfied, making Phainon sighed in relief internally. 

"I'm the one who should say it, ma'am. I'm so glad I met Mydei." 

–

The dining hall –it could only be called that– was massive, similarly decorated with red and gold like the main hall, with one big table in the middle.

The servants had gone back and forth from another door with trays of plates on their hands, bringing so much food that it could only be called a feast now.

Phainon's eyes had sparkled at the dishes, knowing some from when Mydei occasionally cooked for him and excited as he's been starving because the journey from Okhema wasn't short.

Mydei chuckled next to him, teasing, "Save some for everyone else, Deliverer."

"Of course I would. I'm not that hungry." Phainon tried defending himself only to hear his stomach growl in hunger. It was loud enough that Mydei's parents heard which got him embarrassed, but luckily they're very understanding and invited them to sit down.

Eurypon sat at the head of the table with Mydei and Gorgo on each of his side. Since Phainon was next to Mydei when they started sitting, he naturally sat next to him. 

The dining hall looked intimidating, but thankfully the atmosphere was peaceful and Eurypon and Gorgo were very welcoming and Phainon slowly relaxed. Mydei's relaxing and familiar pomegranate and honey pheromones next to him helped as well.

Phainon contemplated the options of food, deciding he's going to try the grilled fish first.

A clink distracted him instead as a bowl of yellow soup was placed next to his plate. 

"Oh, what's this?"

"It's lentil soup."

"...You know I don't like lentils."

"It's nutritious." Mydei sent him a withered glare, "You've been neglecting your nutrition while studying. Eat." He  commanded and Phainon sulked, but didn't try to move the soup as he knew it's for his own good too.

He got his fish and some lamb skewers for starters, although the roasted potatos that Mydei had in front of him looked tempting too…

Mydei's luscious golden hair had grown longer over the course of the last few months where they're so busy finishing up assignments and studying for final exams, so his long hair locks were falling forward toward the bowl.

Phainon sighed and took out the hair band that he recently wore on his wrist every time he went out with Mydei because he knew Mydei would forget, then tapped Mydei's shoulder to show the hair band.

Mydei easily acquiesced, turning his head on the side so Phainon could gather some of the soft hair to tie it into a small bun with practised ease. 

The sound of a loud clink jolted Phainon and he turned to see everyone gaped at him, including Eurypon and Gorgo. Gorgon was the one who dropped the spoon onto her plate as there was a small spatter next to the plate, staining the table cloth.

Phainon opened his mouth to ask, but Gorgo had interrupted him, "Mydeimos, why haven't you told us that your relationship with Phainon has progressed this far?"

Phainon stared at her in confusion, then to Mydei who avoided looking at him but whose cheeks have reddened. 

"Mydei?" Phainon called Mydei, in hopes that he explained, but Mydei ignored him.

"No wonder you insist on a feast." Eurypon said, leaning forward to observe Phainon, "Now we know the reason."

The reason was probably because Mydei knew Phainon ate like a whale, so Phainon was even more confused when Cipher nudged him with her pointy elbow and gave her a smirk, "Congrats on bagging a baddie."

Phainon didn't even know what that meant.

"Tell me, Phainon." Eurypon brought his attention back, "In a burning building, who would you save first if there's Mydei and Gorgo?"

Phainon was baffled at the sudden question, mouth gaping, "Pardon?"

"Answer."

This question felt like a test that he didn't know the answer for. It would be incorrect to choose one between the two, so the answer had to be…

"I would carry both of them to safety in each arm." 

"...Could you?" Eurypon looked at Phainon's covered biceps with doubt.

Phainon might look leaner than Mydei, but he actually had stronger arm strength. His wardrobe just wasn't as revealing as Mydei's who preferred tank tops.

As he was about to defend himself, Mydei intervened quietly, "He can pick me up in one arm."

Mydei! Phainon could cry in joy, although Mydei was looking at the wall opposite of Phainon so he couldn't see his expression.

A sound of claps made Phainon look at the direction of the head of the table. Gorgo had stood up, raising his goblet up in the air while everyone else followed. For the lack of understanding, Phainon raised his too. 

"We are here today to celebrate the day that Mydeimos had found an alpha befitting of him. May Mydeimos and Phainon be blessed with happiness from here on, standing strong together until death." 

Phainon's jaw had slowly dropped to the ground as Gorgo's words seeped into his ear. Did he mishear that Gorgo implied that Phainon was Mydei's mate?

He had to look panicked, so Mydei had clinked his goblet with Phainon's and hissed, "I'll explain later. Just follow it for now."

Mydei had intertwined their hands together somehow when Phainon wasn't paying attention, raising it so Gorgo could notice. He couldn't even enjoy the feeling of Mydei's hand in his hold because he was so confused.

"Thank you, mother."

Then he drank the juice in one gulp. 

"The answer should be to save Mydei first, because I will be the one who saves my wife." Eurypon quipped, earning a slap on his arm from his wife.

–

It was a mess of confusion from there on. 

Phainon prided himself of being adaptable in any situation, but Mydei didn't explain at all and suddenly he was thrusted into a situation that he really wanted to be in with originally.

Being Mydei's real mate? Dream came true.

Phainon was already crushing on Mydei since the second year he met the omega and he was jerking off in a rut, only thinking of blond hair and pomegranate scent the whole time. 

But Phainon was afraid of rejection and while Mydei never denied of his physical touches or if he's sometimes a little bit jealous over those alphas vying for Mydei, he also never seemed to give a green light to Phainon's courting attempts such as giving Mydei flowers or the food he liked. They were accepted and appreciated, but Mydei didn't affirm that he's in love with Phainon. And so, Phainon pined.

Except he apparently did something that made everyone think they're mates, but he hadn't figured out what. But it looked like he should know because everyone had been smiling in approval and even Castorice had commented that she saw it coming. What?

Eurypon especially had grilled him with questions too as if making sure his son's potential mate wasn't some lazy bum. Phainon answered his best and although he's still a broke university student, they seemed to be impressed at his scholarship and that he's also working a part time job so that he didn't burden his parents back at the village.

Mydei escaped to his room as soon as dinner ended, claiming that he's tired. Phainon had let him go, because he could actually ask his friends first before going to Mydei.

Eurypon and Gorgo bid them farewell before long; Gorgo wanting to talk to Mydei and Eurypon back to the office.

–

Aglaea stared at him as if he's an ant beneath her heels. Cipher and Castorice both sport matching looks of incredulity. They're in Aglaea's guest room now for privacy and Phainon felt like he was in a court with how they formed a half circle around him.

"Let me reiterate," Aglaea held one hand up, her voice flat but full of disappointment, "You are not aware of what you have done back at the dinner?"

"...No?"

Cipher cackled, "I should have prepared popcorn!"

Castorice nudged her in reprimanding fashion before she directed her attention at Phainon, "Are you aware of Castrum Kremnos culture of their hair?"

Phainon vaguely nodded, "The hair is sacred, isn't it? I observed in Castrum Kremnos' murals that the hair parts were greatly detailed and usually coloured while the rest of the body was not, but what does it have to do with it?"

"They still honour it until today." Aglaea explained.

Phainon frowned, "I'm aware that usually only close family members can touch a Kremnoan's hair, but Mydei has always been an open-minded person? He has let me braid his hair since last year."

Phainon had been curious about Mydei's hair, he recalled. The two colours of his hair that Mydei said were natural, the hair product that Mydei used that made his hair looked glowing and the way he always had one braid on the side. He asked if he could touch and he wouldn't even take offence if Mydei refused, but Mydei had stared at Phainon for a few seconds then nodded and that was that.

"You all have touched his hair before too, right?" Phainon asked with a tinge of desperation, but three shakes of head answered him.

Aglaea massaged her temple, "That Mydei…"

"He also didn't like to be touched, but he never refused yours." Cipher added, eyes twinkling, "You never realised?"

Phainon gawked, "What?"

"We thought you've been together since last year." Castorice said, eyes laden with disappointment, "You two are always going somewhere together and we know if we want to look for you, we can ask Mydei. Vice versa. We just thought you're waiting for graduation to make it official."

Phainon's heart felt like it's going to burst, "Do you think Mydei likes me?"

Aglaea snorted, a sound that they had never heard from her. She sounded so amused when she spoke next, "Anyone can see that boy is besotted with you as you are with him."

Phainon mumbled a thanks while running to the door, the sound of his footfalls quickly disappeared.

"Atta boy!" Cipher whistled. 

"Finally." Castorice sighed happily.

They gaped when the footsteps came nearer and Phainon showed up, scratching his head in embarrassment, "I don't know where Mydei's room is…"

–

Mydei opened the door before Phainon had even knocked, grumbling, "I can hear the sound of your footsteps. Come in."

He had changed to his usual sleepwear, a tank top and shorts.

His smell was filled with anxiety and guilt, his scent bitter, and Phainon longed to bring Mydei into his embrace to reassure him, but he also understood they needed to talk first.

"I apologise." Mydei started once they sat down on the couch with Phainon opposite him, fingers fidgeting but eyes forward, "I should have told you about the tradition but I indulged myself and let it happen for too long. I will fix this misunderstanding with my parents tomorrow."

"Wait, what do you mean by indulging yourself?" Phainon was at the edge of his seat, hands formed into fists on his thighs.

Mydei's fingers fiddled with his braid, "I know you've never seen me that way so I just want to let it happen until you express interest in someone else."

"Do you mean in a romantic way?" When Mydei nodded hesitantly with a faint blush, Phainon burst out, "Because I've been trying to court you for the last one year but you've never confirmed if you returned my affection."

Mydei blinked, "When?"

"The flowers? The food? The gifts?" Phainon listed incredulously, "In most of the traditions including Okhema and Aedes Elysiae, the way of courting is to prove that alphas are reliable to provide for our omegas and pups. But you- you never said anything!"

Mydei looked speechless, "In Castrum Kremnos, you just need to be equal in all aspects of life. You proved that by our 10 hours of sparring."

"B-but that was when we just met!" Phainon sputtered.

"My mother and father mated after they fought for 10 days even though they didn't know each other before." He explained, "We just met for a few days at that time, but I have acknowledged that you're my equal since then."

Phainon felt his face warm and he said shyly, "Oh. Do you– do you want to mate with me then?"

Mydei blinked and then gave him a shy smile, "Yes, if you'll have me."

He didn't know who started to move first as they met in the middle, lips clashing fiercely with all the pent-up feelings. Phainon could taste the pomegranate lip balm that Mydei always brought with him, making him giddy that he finally could taste it after begging Mydei to try it on because it smelled nice. 

It was even better and sweeter because he tasted it on Mydei himself.

Mydei, who let out a groan that had Phainon's alpha instinct flared up.

Phainon's hands around Mydei's waist tightened while he placed small kisses around Mydei's neck. Phainon always knew Mydei smelled good, but sniffing it from this close was even more addictive.

"Enough." Mydei's breathy voice stopped his thoughts.

Phainon whined, staring up at Mydei whose face was pink.

"We have a bed."

He perked up at Mydei's words, metaphorical tail wagging but he tried to rein it in to ask Mydei again, "Are you sure? Because I won't be able to stop once we start."

Mydei was flustered but he nodded firmly, "I am, Phainon. Are you… sure with me?"

He took Mydei's hands in his, staring at him sincerely, lovingly, with all the devotion that he wanted to express, "I have been since I've met you."

They did feel like teenagers, clothes discarded haphazardly and Phainon's finger trembled so hard when he pushed into Mydei's entrance, already wet with slick that it hardly needed any fingering.

Phainon thought he was the luckiest guy ever as the most gorgeous man then tilted his head to bare his neck.

Like heeding a call from an angel, Phainon bit Mydei's mating gland deeply, sealing their lives together.

–

Phainon could see the exact change in Eurypon's expression when he spotted the mating bite on Mydei's neck, displayed proudly by his mate despite Phainon getting so embarrassed that everyone in the house now knew what transpired last night.

Mydei's parents clearly didn't need to know how he had… defiled their only son, but Mydei seemed so content caressing the bite occasionally that Phainon just decided to bear with it. He also really liked how the mark looked on Mydei, a sign that Mydei was his and no one else.

It still filled him with dread when Mydei dragged Phainon to bid farewell to his parents, walking stiffly like a soldier marched into death.

Gorgo, however, looked ecstatic as her smile widened, "I told you, Mydeimos, just a slight push is needed."

"Mother…"

Phainon's head was swivelling back and forth between the two, eyes widened, "What-"

"We have a lot of potential partners for Mydeimos," Gorgo stared at Phainon now, "But he only wanted you and it is a parent's job to fulfill her son's wish, isn't it?"

He almost growled at the mention of potential partners but his heart sung when Gorgo confirmed that Mydei only wanted him! Only him!

He nudged Mydei who turned flustered again, "Oh, really, Mydei?"

"Shut up." It was lacking any bite, a testament at how embarrassed Mydei was.

"Phainon Khaslana." Eurypon's hand landed on his shoulder, tightly gripping it, "If you hurt Mydeimos…"

"I won't." Phainon firmly answered, "I would have castrated my balls if I hurt him."

At the shocked stares from everyone present, Phainon corrected, "I'm sorry, is that too vulgar? I mean my testicles."

Eurypon stared at him in disbelief, "You swear by it?"

"Yes, of course?" Phainon wondered why everyone was so shocked. Back when one of his neighbours in Aedes Elysiae was found cheating, he repented to his wife by saying if he did it again she was free to castrate his balls. Cyrene had giggled and said it was courageous of him to say that and Phainon finally had the chance to say it so he did. 

Beside, the imagination of Mydei crying in distress made Phainon's heart clenched furiously. 

Eurypon saw something in Phainon's eyes and nodded reluctantly, letting go on his grip on Phainon's shoulder, "Fine. I can see the determination to protect him."

"I don't need protection." Mydei grumbled, crossing his arms.

"You do!" Phainon and Eurypon answered together then having a stare-off with each other before shaking hands.

"Your father must be happy that he can find someone to watch over you while you're at Okhema, Mydeimos." Gorgo had to grin at the sight of his husband and son-in-law bonding over Mydei.

"He's so ridiculous, mother." Mydei complained, although he couldn't hide a small curve on his lips.

She laughed, "Isn't that why you fall for him?"
